budget_note: fidelity sprint FD brief (2026-10-25): each density kit one mesh and one atlas, at most 2 to 3 draw sections; 12000 tris for the kit
tris_note: 10576 against 12000; 3 draw sections (pendant_lamp: architecture_atlas + bulb_glow; window_frame: architecture_atlas)
what: window_frame: a dark steel frame for the studio window (6 cm outer frame, two mullions and two transoms 3.5 cm wide, glazing beads round every pane) and an oak sill; pendant_lamp: a ceiling canopy, a 0.9 m cord, a brass socket, a 32 cm spun steel dome white inside and a warm bulb just below its rim

generator.method: procedural Blender (scripts/art/studio-kit/build_kits.bpy) through the finish stack of scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy: per-part bevels (1140 hard edges), hardened and weighted normals, unique UVs, one 2048 px atlas baked on the CPU from Poly Haven CC0 scans with curvature wear, grunge and AO

materials: pendant_lamp/architecture_atlas: 3868 faces, baked basecolor + ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metal) + tangent normal (OpenGL)
pendant_lamp/bulb_glow: 240 faces, flat emissive (UE drives it)
window_frame/architecture_atlas: 6468 faces, baked basecolor + ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metal) + tangent normal (OpenGL)
textures: textures/architecture_atlas_basecolor.png, textures/architecture_atlas_normal.png, textures/architecture_atlas_orm.png; atlas 719.9 px/m on the visible surface (42 % of the surface hidden and shrunk), bake seconds {"base":3.04,"rough":2.86,"metal":1.02,"normal":2.61,"ao":26.48}; AO also multiplied into basecolor at 0.55 (the forward scene has no runtime AO). GLB embeds JPEG q92
placement: window_frame: into the back wall opening of studio_level.py (Y 40..190 cm, Z 20..280 cm, wall at X = 250): pivot = bottom centre of the opening on the wall's inside face, its depth (+Y, 8 cm) into the wall, the sill proud into the room; yaw -90 on the back wall; REMOVE the shell's mullion and transom boxes (studio_level.py, "A mullion and a transom") it replaces. pendant_lamp: pivot = canopy top on the ceiling (z = 0, hangs down 1.09 m), one over each side desk (instanced: the second costs no draw); give each a warm point light at the bulb (about 0.18 m under the pivot: 0.9 m cord + socket) for the bokeh-like highlights, bulb_glow emissive #FFC27A
axes: Blender Z up, facing -Y; glTF Y-up (Interchange lands Blender -Y on UE -Y)
licence: own procedural work (Blender is a GPL tool; its output is ours); bake inputs CC0: fine_grained_wood (https://polyhaven.com/a/fine_grained_wood, CC0 1.0 (Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/license))
regenerate: node scripts/art/lib/polyhaven.mjs <work>/polyhaven 2k; node scripts/art/lib/polyhaven.mjs <work>/polyhaven 1k --models; blender -b -P scripts/art/studio-kit/build_kits.bpy -- <repo-root> <work> studio-architecture; blender -b -P scripts/art/studio-kit/render_kits.bpy -- <repo-root> studio-architecture; node scripts/art/studio-kit/write_kit_manifest.mjs <work> studio-architecture

input.note: procedural, no generated geometry; CC0 inputs only (Poly Haven scans, licence recorded)
